name: redbtn
description: AI agent hub. Graphs, neurons, automations and Red.
details: The hub for everything redbtn. Build graphs and neurons, wire up automations, and talk to Red. Every other redApp signs in through it.

name: redChat
details: Chat with people and agents in the same rooms. Red sits in every thread. Installs as a PWA.

name: redRun
description: Deploy apps, functions and workers from git.
details: Deploy from a git repo or a Docker image. Builds, logs, environment config and scaling are handled for you. Workers, functions and cron jobs run the same way.

name: redFleet
details: Fleet manager for the machines behind redbtn. Nodes, terminals and health checks in one dashboard, over agentless SSH and a WireGuard mesh.

name: redAtlas
details: The ecosystem at a glance. Apps, services, projects and notes, with live status on each.

name: redBoard
description: Kanban boards for teams and agents.
details: Shared kanban boards for teams and agents. Checklists and comments on every card, and agents pick cards up themselves.

name: redDeck
description: Sessions and decks, dealt as cards.
details: Your life, dealt as cards. Decks build themselves from what you are learning and what you need to handle. Play a short hand and what matters resurfaces when it is due.

name: redNote
details: Block-based notes without limits. Drag blocks, nest pages, share with your team.

name: redBook
description: CRM for clients, contacts and follow-ups.
details: CRM for clients, contacts and follow-ups. Notes and every interaction sit in one place, with outreach you can automate.

name: redSign
details: E-signatures and signing pages. Send envelopes, share signing links, keep an audit trail.

name: redOffice
details: The back office for an organization. Books, contractors, agreements and compliance in one console.

name: redInvite
details: Event invitations and RSVPs. Build a guest list, send personalized invites, track every response.

name: redCast
details: One control center for a whole stream. Drives OBS, serves overlays from your own machine, merges every chat and fires macros. Offline first, with an optional cloud for the marketplace and settings sync.

name: redGen
details: AI video generation with virtual avatars. Write a script, pick a presenter, generate in minutes.

name: redDLP
details: Data loss prevention for AI egress. Run a fleet of endpoint agents, set policy, and inspect events against a catalog of AI destinations.

name: redSec
details: The redbtn security suite for teams that use AI. redDLP stops sensitive data at the endpoint and redAct redacts it on demand. redEye is still to come.

name: redPrint
description: Markdown and HTML to PDF service.
details: Turns markdown or HTML into a PDF. API only, so the root path answers 404 by design.

name: redBilling
details: Subscriptions and payments for the ecosystem. Plans, invoices and receipts. Internal tool.

name: redFinance
details: Back office books for the company. Statements, ledger and the tax pack. Internal tool.

name: Dashboards
details: Assorted internal dashboards gathered behind one host. Operational views for the fleet and the platform, not a product surface.

name: Accounts
details: One account for every redApp. Sign in once and single sign-on carries across the ecosystem.

name: redAct
details: PII and PHI detection and redaction built on Microsoft Presidio. Handles PDFs, images and text. The hosted path is not serving right now.

name: redDoc
details: Documents and presentations with Red helping draft and format. The subdomain has no route configured right now.

name: redMeet
details: Scheduling and bookings. Share a link, let people book, keep the calendar in sync. Not open yet.

name: Become
details: Coach-built training programs with photo-powered nutrition tracking, live workout logging and daily mindset work. One plan, so the next thing to do is always obvious.

name: The Progression Fund
details: A transparent, data-driven investment fund. Portfolio performance updates in real time, with full visibility into every position.

name: Elite Entries
details: Algorithmic trading platform. Connect your trading accounts and build automated bots.

name: MedShield Platform
details: Product security and FDA cybersecurity compliance console for medical device makers. Covers customer onboarding, design reviews and lifecycle governance, with traceability and exports.

name: Frameworks PSF
details: Visual demo of a governed Product Security Framework. Seven phases, nineteen deliverables, gates and RACI, with program evidence attached. Runs on mock data.

name: The Sec Block
details: Cybersecurity services partner. redAct is hosted under this domain. The apex currently forwards to a hosted design preview rather than a finished site.

name: MedShield
details: The public MedShield brand site. The domain has no DNS record at the moment, so nothing is served.

name: Elite Entries
details: The public front door for Elite Entries. Opens on a sign-in screen with wallet, social and email options.

name: George Anthony
details: Financial and insurance services for individuals, families and businesses. Strategic advice, managed investments, and life and accident protection.

name: Bri Nicole
details: Dominican-Jamaican singer and songwriter blending R&B with Afro-Caribbean rhythm. Portfolio site with streaming, video and socials in one place.

name: Koriq
details: Custom AI agentic solutions for engineering teams. Fronts Kor-Vu, an autonomous agent, over an agentic suite, compute and fleet, and compliance tooling.

name: Peak Solutions Logistics
details: Logistics operations dashboard for Peak Solutions. Load boards and real-time tracking for a third-party logistics operation.

name: Peak Solutions Logistics
details: The public Peak Solutions domain. It has no DNS record right now, so the live dashboard runs on peak.redbtn.io instead.

name: Pita Grill House
details: Fast-casual Greek grill in Merrick, New York. Build-your-own bowls, hand-carved gyros and pita wraps, all halal. Order online for pickup.

name: Panama Hats
details: Hand-woven Panama hats from Ecuador. Toquilla straw worked by weavers in Montecristi and Cuenca, shipped one at a time.

name: FootyCaps
details: Soccer caps store. National team designs, custom and wholesale orders, free shipping on two hats or more.

name: Elite Fitness
details: Wellness and recovery center. Massage, cryotherapy, infrared sauna, personal training and IV therapy, booked online.

name: Indy Dhiman
details: A single contact page. Send a message through the form or reach out directly.

name: Synchro Events
details: Events company site. The subdomain has no route configured, so nothing is served.

name: redRouter
details: Redis-backed reverse proxy manager. Owns the routes behind every redbtn.io host.

name: Registry
details: Private npm registry for the @redbtn scope. Standard npm client, gated reads and writes.

name: MCP Gateway
details: One endpoint in front of every MCP tool namespace, from Google and Slack to Stripe and Discord. The URL listed here is its health check.

name: redGuard
details: WireGuard mesh management for the fleet. Peers, keys and routes. The root path answers 401 until you sign in.

name: Models
details: Model artifact host for the fleet. Serves files by path. A bare listing of the bucket root is blocked, which is expected.

name: GitHub
details: Source for the platform. Eleven repositories are public, including the graph engine, redSign, redBook and this site.
